# R/bayz Documentation

R/bayz provides Bayesian mixed models, shrinkage regression, kernel-based random effects,
interaction kernels, and feature-set regression through the main `bayz()` interface.

Use the top navigation for the main documentation pages:

- [Overview and installation](index.html)
- [Bayz interface and model building](BayzModels.html)
- [Using bayz output](UsingOutput.html)
- [Help index](HelpIndex.html)

The pages rendered through Quarto include a navigation bar at the top and a table of contents on the right.
